bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'CREATEVDOBOT_DEPLOY_OWNER_READONLY\n'
container=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
stage=$(docker inspect --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.working_dir"}}' "$container")
printf 'STAGE_DIR=%s\n' "$stage"
printf 'STAGE_REALPATH='; realpath "$stage"
printf 'STAGE_CONTENTS\n'; ls -ld "$stage" "$stage/.." "$stage/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" "$stage/../src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs" "$stage/../owner/gateOwner.mjs" 2>&1
printf 'STAGE_UI_GUIDE\n'; grep -n '変更したい項目の' "$stage/../src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs" || true
printf 'STAGE_GATE\n'; grep -n 'VIDEO_TOPIC_NOT_CONNECTED\|VIDEO_REVIEW_NOT_CONNECTED' "$stage/../owner/gateOwner.mjs" || true
printf 'STAGE_GIT='; git -C "$stage/.." rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo NO_GIT
printf 'STAGE_COMPOSE_PROJECT\n'; grep -n 'project:\|container_name:\|services:\|image:\|build:\|context:\|dockerfile:' "$stage/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" | head -30 || true
printf 'OWNER_SCRIPTS\n'; find /home/gace/Project/Gserver/repository/scripts -maxdepth 1 -type f -iname '*app*' -o -iname '*video*' 2>/dev/null | head -12 || true
printf 'STAGE_DIRS\n'; find /home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -printf '%f\n' | head -20
